name: 16c pipeline 1f1b
title: One-forward-one-backward schedule on four stages
subtitle: Four pipeline stages, eight micro-batches; forward (F) and backward (B) passes drawn one slot each

steps.caption: Slots 1 to 4 fill the pipeline: micro-batch 1 moves down one stage per slot while stage 1 keeps starting new forwards. Stage 1 now holds activations for 4 micro-batches.
Slot 5: stage 4 has the loss for micro-batch 1, so it runs that backward pass at once instead of starting another forward.
Slots 6 to 8: the backward of micro-batch 1 climbs to stage 1, freeing its activations at each stage. Stages 3 and 2 already alternate one forward with one backward.
Slots 9 to 16 are the steady state: every stage is busy, alternating one forward and one backward, and stage 1 never holds more than 4 micro-batches at once.
Slots 17 to 22 drain the pipeline: the last backwards climb up while the lower stages run out of work.

Each stage is busy 16 of 22 slots, so the bubble is 6/22 = 3/11 = 27%, the same as (p - 1)/(m + p - 1). Running all 8 forwards first gives the same bubble but makes stage 1 hold 8 micro-batches, not 4.
